prior_verdict.summary: Minimal, well-scoped CSS override to fix WCAG AA contrast compliance issue. No correctness bugs or design concerns identified.

verdict.summary: Fix verified and approved. Contrast ratio calculation confirmed: #FF8080 on #1D1F21 = 6.811:1 (exceeds WCAG AA requirement of 4.5:1). CSS override is isolated, targeted, and introduces no regressions.

scope_check.notes: Change is isolated to Ace Editor theme overrides. Targets specific token classes: .ace_entity, .ace_variable, .ace_string.ace_regexp, .ace_meta.ace_tag. No impact on other components or themes.

regression_check.notes: CSS override uses !important to ensure Ace theme is overridden. Does not affect light theme (tomorrow) or other editors. Other syntax colors unchanged.

accessibility_check.notes: Directly addresses WCAG AA accessibility issue. Improves contrast for users with color vision deficiency. No negative impact on any user group.

decision.reason: Fix is minimal, correct, and directly solves the accessibility issue without side effects. Contrast ratio verified to exceed WCAG AA requirements. Ready for merge.
